system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Animal Handling and Survival, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Animal Husbandry Lore, Grazing Lands Lore, Lore of a chosen livestock species.
system.description: You guided livestock between pasture and shelter, keeping scattered animals together through difficult country. You learned to notice a troubled beast before the rest of the herd followed its example.
